title: Integral Calculus

sections.heading: 1. Indefinite Integration
sections.proseLatex: Standard forms, substitution, integration by parts ($\int u\,dv = uv - \int v\,du$), partial fractions.

sections.heading: 2. Definite Integrals & Properties
sections.proseLatex: Evaluate $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx = F(b) - F(a)$. Odd functions integrate to 0 over symmetric intervals.

keyFormulas.label: Symmetry Property
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Use parity to simplify definite integrals.

stepsLatex: $\int g(f+f')\,dx = gf - \int g'f\,dx + \int gf\,dx = gf + c$.
